subject: zoology_2
question_text: Describe the genetic basis of ABO blood grouping.

mark_split.label: The gene and its three alleles

verification.note: Sourced from 'My Baby Bullet-Q — Senior Inter Zoology' (Star-Q Pass Track Series, Sri Publishers, 2022), book p.39, SAQ 34. The printed exam years are the book's claim, reproduced here as appearances. Zoology-II holds only ONE source book in the corpus, so the two-book union check is structurally impossible for this card; 'not checked' does NOT mean 'checked and clean'. steps.label: The gene and its alleles
steps.why: One gene with three alleles is what makes the ABO system the standard example of multiple alleles.
common_mistakes: Naming three genes. There is one gene with three alleles.
Getting the chromosome wrong. It is chromosome 9.
steps.margin_note: Name both scientists. Both are marked.
lines: Karl Landsteiner proposed the ABO system
The genetic basis depends on three alleles
of the gene I on chromosome 9, discovered

lines.text: The alleles are Iᴬ, Iᴮ and Iᴼ (or i)

steps.label: What each allele makes
steps.why: The Iᴼ allele makes no antigen at all, which is why group O red cells carry nothing on their surface.
common_mistakes: Saying Iᴼ makes an antigen. It makes none.
steps.memory_tip: Iᴬ makes A, Iᴮ makes B, Iᴼ makes nothing.
steps.margin_note: Three short lines cover this mark.
lines: Iᴬ produces antigen A and Iᴮ produces
Iᴼ does not produce any antigen.

steps.label: The six genotypes
steps.why: Each parent contributes one allele, so every possible pair of the three alleles is a possible genotype.
common_mistakes: Writing IᴼIᴬ and IᴬIᴼ as two different genotypes.
steps.memory_tip: Three same-pairs and three mixed pairs make six.
steps.margin_note: Write all six on one line.
lines: A child receives one of the three alleles
from each parent, giving six possible
genotypes and four possible blood types.

lines.text: IᴬIᴬ, IᴬIᴼ, IᴮIᴮ, IᴮIᴼ, IᴬIᴮ, IᴼIᴼ

steps.label: The four phenotypes
steps.why: Because Iᴼ is recessive, a person carrying it with Iᴬ or Iᴮ looks exactly like one carrying two of the dominant allele.
common_mistakes: Giving IᴬIᴮ the A group. It is AB, because the two are codominant.
steps.memory_tip: Six genotypes collapse into four groups.
steps.margin_note: Group the genotypes under the four blood types.
lines: IᴬIᴬ and IᴬIᴼ are A group blood.
IᴮIᴮ and IᴮIᴼ are B group blood.

insider_note: This is the middle half of the 8-mark question. Write the six genotypes as a single line — the examiner counts them.
